blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 25535156 on 2026-07-15, autoUSD proxy 0xa7569a44f348d3d70d8ad5889e50f78e33d80d35 resolved to verified AutopoolETH implementation 0xfb2ebdedc38a7d19080e44ab1d621bc9afad0695 and EIP-1967 ProxyAdmin 0x84a317a45248d6d3f92f40102680ffeda2ab95c0. The implementation applies whenNotPaused to both transfer and transferFrom. Its inherited pause and unpause functions require the Auto Finance AccessController EMERGENCY_PAUSER role, and SystemSecurity's same-role pauseSystem can pause every connected pool. At the pinned block, autoUSD paused() and isShutdown() were false, SystemSecurity was not paused, and the AccessController enumerated four EMERGENCY_PAUSER accounts. Any one of those role holders can block all current autoUSD holder transfers; no per-address blacklist is required for this direct Yes. Issuer documentation, audit, GitHub, archive, legal-route, and transparency review supplied no narrower legal exception or independent PoR claim. The separate underlying-USDC exposure remains additive.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: autoUSD has one tracked Ethereum autopool contract and no modeled bridge route in Pharos. The Royco Dawn market wraps that Ethereum vault token into senior and junior tranche vaults.
